title: ochrosia coccinea var. peekelii
intro: Ochrosia coccinea var. peekelii, commonly known as the Coral Wood or Peekel's Ochrosia, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Australia and Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Ochrosia coccinea var. peekelii include its ability to act as a sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic, making it a potential treatment for anxiety disorders, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities.
